name: MoYu AoLong 3x3 V5 (Magnetic, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, MagLev, UV Coated)
description: The MoYu AoLong 3x3 V5 (Magnetic, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, MagLev, UV Coated) is the top of the V5 line — 100 magnets in total, with 20 inside the ball core for the densest magnetic field MoYu put into this cube. MagLev suspension, corner-to-core auto-alignment, and dual-axis tuning all carry over from the 8-magnet version, with the 20-magnet core delivering noticeably sharper snap on every turn.
features: MagLev suspension: Repelling magnets replace springs throughout, delivering the fastest, lightest turning feel in the V5 lineup.
64 tuning combinations: 8 MagLev tension levels × 8 distance settings — the full dual-axis tuning range with MagLev under both axes.
UV Coated finish: High-grip glossy surface built for confident control at speed.
Dual adjustment system: MagLev tension and distance are independently adjustable — zero interference between the two axes.
8 MagLev tension levels: Dial in resistance from soft and fluid to firm and responsive without touching the distance setting.
8 distance settings: Set how close the layers sit to the core — affects corner-cutting angle, stability, and overall turning character.
